title: Cervical Cancer Free Since 2009
content: Cervical Cancer Free Since 2009Radical Remission ProjectJan 4, 20241 min readIn 2009, Mana was diagnosed with a rare strain of cervical cancer. After her surgery and biopsy, she was categorized in the highest risk group for recurrence. There was no Radical Remission information available back then, but her intuition kept telling her what to do, and she ended up incorporating all of the healing factors.
